title: What happens if the selector is wrong
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: Worth seeing once. `payload.customers` does not exist here, and filtering null gives null rather than an error — so a mistyped selector produces an empty-looking result instead of a stack trace. Every array function behaves this way.
